title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། གི (Derge Tengyur, vol. 112)
shelf_note: Canonical Tibetan Buddhist treatise from the Madhyamaka (dbu ma) section of the Derge Tengyur (volume gi / 112).

ocr_errors.problem: Stray hash characters (#) inserted at five points across the transcription

tr_errors_A.english: if one provides joy to sentient beings, or speaks pleasantly, or acts purposefully, or gathers them through consistency of purpose, but does not do so from the state of merely being words ... up to the point of transformation
tr_errors_A.problem: Misparses negative syntax regarding the four means of gathering disciples (saṃgrahavastu), inverting the condition and inventing 'up to the point of transformation' for 'tshig tsam gyi dngos po'i bar du 'gyur ba'
Omits 'King' (rgyal po) in the city name Vyūharāja (Bkod pa'i rgyal po)

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B accurately parses the opening conditional statement on the four means of gathering disciples which Translation A distorts, correctly translates proper names and technical terminology, and formats the verse quotations with appropriate line breaks.

book_verdict: Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka folio 20 correctly scanned and transcribed aside from stray hash markers; Translation B is faithful, precise, and properly formatted, whereas Translation A misparses the opening doctrinal passage.
